the best evaluation method is the one that best fits the task at hand, and that there is no one-size-fits-all solution.
there is no single best evaluation method for large-scale document summarization.
none of the existing evaluation measures is perfect.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ROUGE and the human evaluations have the best correlation with the human judgments.
the evaluation measures are very good for single-document summarization, but not so for multi-document summarization.
ROUGE is the best evaluation method in the current state of the art.
The main takeaway from our work is that
no single evaluation method is sufficient for evaluating summarization.
there is no silver bullet evaluation metric for automatic summarization and the choice of the evaluation method depends on the application scenario.
the evaluation of summarizers is a complex task that needs to take many aspects of summarizers into account.
